All Tathāgatas, endowed with the ten great powers, constantly provide protection.
Possessing such vast majesty and virtue, they practice the path of bodhi to deliver you from the great terrors of birth and death within the ocean of suffering of saṃsāra.

The mind of the knower attains purity and transforms into the supreme and auspicious samādhi;

All undertakings shall be successfully accomplished;
all afflictions shall be fully liberated from;

At that time, the Buddha Prabhāsa said:
"That person has entered the lineage of the Tathāgata."
This is the power of the true lion’s radiance and so forth;
it enables gods and humans who possess the power of diligence to attain that Tathāgata,
the most supremely majestic and renowned Mahāsattva.
He is most excellent in skillfully understanding the characteristics of phenomena and in benefiting others.
Furthermore, that Buddha said:
"With a mind detached from desire, joy arises and afflictions do not emerge."
Abiding well in joy, they give rise to the vast mind and remain secure throughout the long night.
The Bodhisattva Tārā will cherish and protect them,
and they shall further obtain the protection of all devas, nāgas, ghosts, and spirits.
Filled with wonder at this unprecedented marvel, they rejoiced with great joy and delight;
prostrating themselves with palms joined, they stood and offered praise.
